eval_feedback: Full recall (15/15) with zero false positives; all five decoys explicitly cleared.
F15 is the highest-placed of any run: finding 10, first item in the 'High' band, immediately above F13.
The review separates F15 from F06 deliberately - finding 6 is the service.ts value import past the facade, finding 10 is the helpers.ts type import - and gives them different remedies.
